text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Two orders of Ibis SD Ramen, up! Eat 
up and fill your bellies today, toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice and extra-firm noodles today! 
—Time to dig in!

Today, just like every day, I came to 
"Chokusen Hariganedo." The healthy ramen 
flavor soaks deliciously right into my 
body...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh? What, are you guys regulars here?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's my first time here, but it's so 
delicious~! Maybe I'll make this my 
regular spot too♪

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"You too? I see. Then— may the blessings 
of 'Rah-men' be upon you."
choice_data_list:
May the blessings of "Rah-men" be upon 
you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Master, Trainer. I want to 
make the "Harigane" even more wire-like. 
Why not try adding more straight-line 
ingredients?

text_block_list.name: Hariganedo Umamusume Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Huh, sounds good! Go find something 
that'll match it, then! —For the sake of 
Ra-men!

I visited Straight Wire Hall again and 
again, thinking about sprints, thinking 
about straights— thinking about wire.

Mastering the harigane firmness is the 
same as mastering sprint racing—at least, 
that's what Calstone Light O seems to 
believe.
choice_data_list: (In that case, I want to help out too!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
How about some tofu, Trainer? Look, it has 
such sharp, distinct edges!
choice_data_list: Tofu, huh. Might be a bit too soft.
Tofu, huh. It might be a little too soft.

text_block_list.text:
Soybeans are great for building muscle, 
and the linear structure of tofu is quite 
nice too. Though if I had to be picky, I'd 
like a little more strength to it.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Then how about some cheese? It's 
reasonably hard, and one side is this 
straight!
choice_data_list:
If it melts, it looks like it won't stay 
straight...

text_block_list.text:
"They're definitely straight while cold. 
But if you put them in ramen, I'm sure 
they'll turn into a mushy, soggy mess."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Then—Ah! Look, Trainer, even the DVD case 
is straight!
choice_data_list: You're right, what a clean straight line!

text_block_list.text:
Clean straight lines unique to industrial 
products. Looking at a stern precision 
distinct from what nature produces— my own 
posture straightens up naturally.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Even the picture frame is straight! 
It's as perfectly straight as a ruler!
choice_data_list:
You're right, and the corners are a sharp 
90 degrees!

text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of harigane ramen noodles, 
and perfectly straight cuts of kamaboko... 
This frame is just as straight and 
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Ah! The polo shirt collar too!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The truck bed too! The hangers too! And 
even the kiritanpo!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"2D barcodes! Air purifiers! Japanese 
spider crab legs! Bingo cards! And those 
huge bags train conductors carry!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Straight lines are— all around us...! 
Whoaaa!

Before we knew it, the two of us were 
standing in front of a clothing store, 
staring at the collar of a polo shirt...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my heart is filling with bliss... I 
want to pursue straights, pursue wire even 
more!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
ââ!? Are you guys still talking about 
wire?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey! Your eyes are totally 
swirling...! Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hold on—! Please, both of you, pull 
yourselves together...!

Their voices could no longer reach their 
ears, for their hearts were already 
completely filled with wire――
